SELECT 
    s.signalregistry AS signal_id,
    s.signalclass AS signal_type,
    CONCAT(
        sd.freqstab, ', ',
        sd.phasestab, ', ',
        sd.sigintegrity
    ) AS stability_report,
    sc.sigpattern AS pattern_label
FROM 
    signals s
JOIN 
    signaldynamics sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
JOIN 
    signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref;

events.sql:
SELECT 
    s.signalregistry AS signal_id,
    s.signalclass AS signal_type,
    CONCAT(
        sd.freqstab, ', ',
        sd.phasestab, ', ',
        sd.sigintegrity
    ) AS stability_report,
    sc.sigpattern AS pattern_label
FROM 
    signals s
JOIN 
    signaldynamics sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
JOIN 
    signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref;
